description: Header file defining the DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher class responsible for fetching PAC files via DHCP on Windows, including its internal state machine, related classes, and methods.

classes.name: DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: Main class managing DHCP-based PAC file fetching, including state management, fetch initiation, cancellation, and result retrieval.

classes.name: DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher::DhcpQuery
classes.description: Inner class handling DHCP URL queries on worker threads, with methods to perform DHCP lookups and retrieve URLs.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Starts the process of fetching the PAC file for a specified network adapter.

methods.name: DidFinish
methods.description: Checks if the fetch process has completed successfully.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Returns the network error code resulting from the fetch operation.

methods.name: GetPacScript
methods.description: Retrieves the fetched PAC script content if available.

methods.name: GetPacURL
methods.description: Retrieves the PAC URL obtained from DHCP.

methods.name: GetPacURLFromDhcp
methods.description: Static method to synchronously get the PAC URL from DHCP for a given adapter.

methods.name: SanitizeDhcpApiString
methods.description: Sanitizes strings returned by the DHCP API.
